name: Genetic Soft Tissue Tumor

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Soft Tissue Tumor Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic germline mutation associated with soft tissue tumor predisposition
Histological confirmation of soft tissue tumor with characteristic features
Positive family history of similar soft tissue tumors in first-degree relatives
Presence of multiple or recurrent soft tissue tumors without other known risk factors

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pathogenic germline mutation plus histopathological confirmation of tumor
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is critical for definitive diagnosis; family history supports but is not mandatory.

searchTerms: multiple soft lumps under the skin

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; possible mild inflammatory markers elevation if tumor inflamed
imaging: MRI showing well-circumscribed soft tissue masses with heterogeneous signal intensity
Ultrasound demonstrating hypoechoic nodules with vascularity
genetic: Pathogenic germline mutations in tumor suppressor genes or oncogenes associated with soft tissue tumor predisposition
other: Histopathology revealing spindle cell proliferation with variable cellularity and collagen deposition

redFlags: Ulceration or bleeding from tumor site
New onset neurological deficits adjacent to tumor
